basics.name: Stéphan Zych
basics.tagline: Lead Developer · Frontend Architect · Technical Co-Founder / CTO

summary: Technical leader with 15+ years delivering web platforms, evolving from frontend development into lead developer, CTO, and architecture-driven roles. My background combines deep frontend expertise with strong full-stack implementation across modern JavaScript and PHP ecosystems — WordPress, Laravel, React, Vue, and component-based templating systems.

I specialise in building the technical foundations that help teams deliver better: architecture, tooling, conventions, developer experience, and pragmatic standardisation. Across agency, founder, and international consulting environments, I have led teams, shaped delivery processes, advised on technical scope, and stayed hands-on in the implementation of scalable, maintainable, high-performance web platforms.
expertise: Team mentoring, onboarding & engineering best practices

experience.summary: Lead developer within a larger international structure following the integration of Cherry Pulp into CBTW. My role combines hands-on technical delivery with cross-team alignment — normalising processes, improving consistency between development teams, and evolving shared tooling and project foundations.
highlights: Contribute to the standardisation of technologies, workflows, and development conventions across teams
Maintain and evolve internal tooling and boilerplates originally developed at Cherry Pulp and still used within CBTW
Improve team workflows through automation, practical processes, and developer-experience enhancements
Work across distributed teams and international project contexts
Expand technical scope through enterprise environments using Microsoft internal tooling and AWS
Contribute to architecture, debugging, delivery support, and project structuring across multiple concurrent projects

experience.summary: Co-founded and helped grow Cherry Pulp, a digital agency focused on custom websites, digital platforms, and web applications. My role evolved from frontend leadership into broader technical ownership — architecture, tooling, delivery foundations, scoping, team support, and technical decision-making across the company.

groups.label: Key achievements
items: Delivered 200+ web platforms and digital products
Helped grow the company from 4 to 20 people
Supported and mentored development teams, up to 10–12 developers at peak
Contributed to the company's evolution until its acquisition by CBTW in 2023

groups.label: Responsibilities & impact
items: Defined technical direction, project architecture, and stack choices across client projects
Built and maintained reusable boilerplates, conventions, and CLI/tooling to streamline setup and long-term maintenance
Improved developer experience and delivery consistency through standardised workflows and shared foundations
Played a key role in technical scoping, estimation, and client advisory during discovery and delivery
Contributed to technical hiring, onboarding, and knowledge sharing across the team

experience.note: Designed a modular web delivery approach around Docker, WordPress with Bedrock, structured conventions, and custom deployment workflows using Forge and Lightsail — making setup faster, maintenance easier, and delivery more consistent for development teams.

experience.summary: Full-stack development of websites and digital platforms with a strong focus on semantic markup, performance, and maintainable architectures.

interests: AI-assisted development workflows & local LLM tooling
